messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — staging rollout for dedicated capacity starts next Mon (3/23). Need final owners and any blockers we should triage now.
Mike: Procurement update: first H100 rack hits SFO on Wed 3/18, ETA to DC on 3/20. Firmware vendor provided 2.0.1, but we should schedule a smoke flash before rack join.
Tara: Canary config PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/482 — needs runtime review (specifically batch timeout and cache warmup). ping @Chen
Chen: Saw the PR. One note: reservation API still has the race on duplicate reservations. I added a repro case in comments. Blocking for automated reservation flow.
infra-bot: Reservation created: res-78f3 (owner: @Alex) — assigned to infra-team.
Alex: @Chen can you post the repro steps here? If it's small we can hotfix, otherwise we gate automated reservations and do manual tickets for the first 2 weeks.
Chen: repro snippet:
```:
# create two reservations quickly
curl -X POST /v1/reservations -d '{"pool":"canary","nodes":2}' &
curl -X POST /v1/reservations -d '{"pool":"canary","nodes":2}' &
# sometimes returns two active reservations -> double-book
```
Tara: Ok. For the rollout we can start with manual reservations (owned by runtime) until the API fix lands. I'll update the runbook.
Mike: Ops note: power tests on rack 5 show 3% headroom; need to stagger spin-ups. Suggest max concurrent nodes per AZ = 6.
Alex: New plan: staggered ramp — week1 canary (2 nodes), week2 ramp to 6, week3 full 12. Assignments: procurement -> Mike, runtime reservations/runbook -> Tara, API fix -> Chen, oncall monitoring alert -> @Lena
Lena: I'll add alerts (token-level latency + GPU memory pressure). Will also add a graph on the console dashboard.
Sam: Quick cost check — what's estimated monthly burn for the first 12 nodes H100? Rough number please.
Mike: Rough calc: 12 x H100 equiv ~ $38k/month (spot mix) / $52k (reserved). I'll attach spreadsheet later.
Alex: Can folks acknowledge owners and blockers? If Chen needs pairing, I can carve out 2 hours tomorrow morning.
Chen: Acknowledge. I might need access to a canary reservation to reproduce; Tara can you grant?
Tara: Done — granted `canary-test` role to Chen.
Alex: Awesome. I'll follow up with a short async checkpoint on Fri. :thumbsup:
